name: Bus-coupler bay primary arrangement
summary: Groups the devices assigned to the connection between two named buses.
description: Groups the devices assigned to the connection between two named buses. A bay circuit arrangement groups the switching, measuring and protection interfaces associated with a specific network circuit. A line bay, transformer bay and reactor bay share some devices but connect different kinds of primary equipment.

In a switchyard single-line drawing, the bay arrangement helps the reader follow the circuit from its bus connection to the external line, transformer or compensation equipment and identify the measurement boundaries along the path. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Two bus conductors” at the input and “Coupler bay connection” at the output. Its protection role differs from a line bay.
